hero.badge: ✨ Welcome to Magic Island • Your Adventure Destination
hero.headline: YOUR ADVENTURE STARTS HERE
hero.supportingText: Discover unforgettable moments at Magic Island – your ultimate destination for water adventures, dinosaur exploration, and thrilling rides.
hero.description: Discover unforgettable moments at Magic Island – your ultimate destination for water adventures, dinosaur exploration, and thrilling rides.

intro.heading: ONE DESTINATION. ENDLESS ADVENTURES.
intro.statement1: Magic Island is an all-in-one entertainment destination.
intro.statement2: You'll find the largest Wave pool in Bangladesh at our Water park.
intro.statement3: The largest variety of dinosaurs is in the Dino Zone.
intro.statement4: Amazing and Thrilling Rides at our Amusement Park.
intro.subtext: Spanning lush landscapes just 20 minutes from Dhaka, Magic Island brings together world-class aquatic fun, roaring prehistoric wonders, and gravity-defying thrill rides into an unforgettable day for family, friends, and adventure seekers.

finalCta.heading: YOUR NEXT GREAT ADVENTURE IS WAITING.
finalCta.subtext: Step into Bangladesh's crowning entertainment kingdom. Book your tickets online today or explore the park experiences.

zones.sectionBadge: Three Unforgettable Worlds in One Kingdom
zones.sectionDesc: Whether you crave gigantic tsunami waves, towering prehistoric roars, or high-velocity G-force loops, Magic Island delivers non-stop wonder.
zones.waterParkDesc: Immerse yourself in our massive artificial ocean wave pool, twist through enclosed vortex slides, or float along the lazy river.
zones.dinoZoneDesc: Step into a lush prehistoric jungle with 25+ animatronic dinosaurs that move, breathe, and roar with staggering realism.
zones.amusementParkDesc: Experience gravity-defying coaster drops, the iconic 150-foot panoramic Ferris Wheel, and high-energy family carnival attractions.

adventureQuiz.title: Find Your Perfect Park Adventure
adventureQuiz.subtitle: Tell us who you're visiting with and your adrenaline preference to discover tailored ride itineraries.

tickets.title: Choose Your Magic Pass
tickets.subtitle: Select from our day passes or all-access passports. All rates are data-driven and previewed below.
tickets.placeholderBanner: Special Preview Pricing: Current prices and early-bird discount codes are preliminary structural values. Final commercial rates will be published prior to grand opening.
tickets.childFreeHint: Children under 3 ft enter free with adult
tickets.faqSubtitle: Frequently asked questions regarding admission, children rates, and entry policies.

booking.title: Ticket Booking & Reservation
booking.subtitle: Complete your reservation online in simple steps with instant confirmation reference.
booking.selectDateDesc: Park gates open daily. Pre-booking guarantees express entry.
booking.guestDetailsDesc: We will send your booking confirmation reference, SMS receipt, and digital pass to these details.
booking.whatsappInquiryDesc: Prefer talking to our reservations team directly? Send an instant inquiry with your selected parameters.

payment.title: Secure Payment Gateway
payment.subtitle: Select your preferred payment channel. All transactions are protected by 256-bit encryption.
payment.sandboxNotice: Sandbox / Preview Mode Active: This environment demonstrates the verified server-side payment lifecycle without charging live financial cards.
payment.sslcommerzDesc: Pay using Debit/Credit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) or mobile wallets (bKash, Nagad, Rocket).
payment.bkashDesc: Direct instant checkout via official bKash merchant gateway.
payment.nagadDesc: Fast and secure checkout via Nagad digital payment gateway.
payment.payAtGateDesc: Reserve your tickets online now and pay cash or card at the park entrance VIP counter.

confirmation.rule1: Present this digital pass or booking reference at the Express Entrance turnstiles.
confirmation.rule2: Proper modest swimwear is required for all Water Park slides and wave pool areas.
confirmation.rule3: Outside food and beverages are strictly prohibited; multiple dining outlets are available inside.
confirmation.rule4: Children must be accompanied by an adult guardian at all times.
confirmation.needAssistance: Need help or changes to your booking? Contact our reservation desk with your reference code.

lookup.title: Find My Booking / Ticket Pass
lookup.subtitle: Lost your confirmation or need to verify your ticket status? Enter your booking reference or registered phone number.
lookup.inputPlaceholder: Enter Booking Ref (e.g., MI-202611-ABCD) or Mobile Number
lookup.notFound: No booking found matching the provided reference or phone number. Please verify and try again.

location.title: Park Location & Directions
location.subtitle: Important Announcement: Official physical site address and Google Maps pin are currently pending commercial inauguration confirmation.
location.placeholderNotice: Location Announcement Notice: Magic Island is currently in final site preparation stages in Bangladesh. Exact GPS coordinates, highway exit numbers, and satellite map pins will be updated right here upon official announcement.
location.editableConfigNotice: Configurable Notice: Business administrators can update the address in config/business.ts or via environment variables to update this page automatically.
location.tip1Desc: Air-conditioned direct express shuttles are planned from major transit hubs on weekends and holidays.
location.tip2Desc: Over 1,200 secure vehicle parking bays for family cars, tour buses, and motorcycles.
location.tip3Desc: Smooth ride-share (Uber/Pathao) drop-off and pickup concourse right in front of the grand ticketing plaza.
location.operatingHoursDesc: Schedule subject to seasonal sunlight and special festival evenings.

gallery.title: Moments of Pure Magic
gallery.subtitle: Browse high-resolution glimpses of our world-class rides, dinosaur jungle trails, and wave pool spectacles.

events.title: Host Your Next Grand Celebration
events.subtitle: Unforgettable company picnics, school excursions, milestone birthday bashes, and exclusive park buyouts.
events.corporateDesc: Reward your employees and families with private marquee tents, customized buffet dining, and team-building competitions.
events.schoolDesc: Inspire students with our interactive prehistoric dinosaur biology trail and hands-on physics of rollercoasters.
events.birthdayDesc: Private birthday pavilion, mascot appearances, personalized birthday cake, and priority ride wristbands.

footer.about: Magic Island is Bangladesh's premier world-class leisure wonderland combining high-octane water adventures, prehistoric Jurassic encounters, and international standard amusement park rides.
footer.newsletterDesc: Subscribe to receive official grand opening announcements and exclusive preview discounts.
footer.copyright: All rights reserved. Magic Island Leisure & Hospitality Ltd.
footer.disclaimer: All trademarks, ride names, and promotional material are subject to regulatory approvals. Displayed prices and schedules are preliminary architectural demonstrations.
